offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sources replacement parts for vehicles, sold mainly to aftermarket parts retailers and warehouse distributors. Two main segments: Vehicle Control (engine management, ignition, emissions, electrical and safety parts) and Temperature Control (air conditioning and engine cooling parts). Also supplies heavy duty and light commercial vehicle parts.

primary_products.value: engine management and ignition parts; fuel system and emissions parts; air conditioning compressors and components; engine cooling and thermal parts; wire and cable sets; switches and electrical parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive aftermarket retailers, warehouse distributors, original equipment service channels and professional installers

end_markets.value: automotive aftermarket; light vehicle replacement parts; heavy duty and commercial vehicle parts

revenue_model.value: product sales: replacement vehicle parts sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes and sources parts from components and contract suppliers, sold to aftermarket retailers and distributors; brand owner: markets parts under its own and private-label brands

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, with some sales in Europe, Asia and Latin America, plants in North America, Poland and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: vehicle control (engine management) parts and temperature control parts, sharing aftermarket customers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: large auto parts retail chains; distributors / dealers: warehouse distributors and jobbers serving professional installers; direct sales: original equipment manufacturers and service parts channels
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions, refrigerant and product safety rules (EPA, CARB), plus tariffs and trade rules on imports

notes: Segment mix and recent divestitures or acquisitions may have changed since training data.
